{{Quote|Lots of carbon scoring here. You've both seen a lot of action.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode IV">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
[[File:MillenniumFalconBottomCarbonScoring-ANH.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' had experienced heavy damage over the years, which caused a large amount of carbon scoring on the hull.]]
'''Carbon scoring''' was a type of burned residue mark left by low-grade gas on the plating of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. After their experience escaping from the Tantive IV and venturing through the Jundland Wastes, both C-3PO and R2-D2 had a lot of carbon scoring, something Luke Skywalker noted when he examined them.<ref name="Episode IV" />
